name: Miss Cherry Fruits

features.name: Expanding wild respins
features.description: Wilds expand and award respins, up to three in a row.

features.name: Classic fruits
features.description: No free spins, just a simple fruit layout.

review:
A simple 20-line fruit slot where lines pay both ways, so small wins land a lot.

The one feature is the Miss Cherry wild: it expands over its reel and gives you a respin, another wild gives another respin – up to three in a row – and the expanded wilds stay, so each respin has more coverage. No free spins. Medium volatility, a 1,000x cap and 96.13% RTP. Relaxed rather than explosive.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
